Texas Truck Accident Lawyer (2025 Guide): Protecting Your Rights After a Crash

If you’ve been hit by an 18-wheeler or commercial truck in Texas, you already know: it’s not like a regular car accident. Truck crashes often mean serious injuries, higher medical bills, and more complicated legal battles.

That’s why you need an experienced Texas truck accident lawyer who understands how to fight the trucking companies—and win.

At The Lange Firm, we help truck accident victims across Texas hold negligent drivers and companies accountable.

Why Truck Accidents Are So Dangerous

Big trucks can weigh up to 80,000 pounds. When they collide with passenger cars, the results are often catastrophic. Victims may suffer:

  • Traumatic brain injuries

  • Spinal cord injuries

  • Broken bones

  • Internal organ damage

  • Permanent disability or death

These aren’t minor injuries—and the compensation needs to reflect that.

What Causes Most Truck Accidents in Texas?

Truck accidents can happen anywhere—on highways like I-10, I-45, or rural roads across Texas. Common causes include:

  • Driver fatigue

  • Distracted driving

  • Speeding or reckless driving

  • Improperly loaded cargo

  • Equipment failure or lack of maintenance

  • Driving under the influence

These aren’t just accidents—they’re often preventable.

Who Can Be Held Liable in a Truck Crash?

One of the biggest differences between car and truck accidents is liability. In a truck crash, multiple parties may be responsible:

  • The truck driver

  • The trucking company

  • The cargo loader

  • The truck manufacturer or maintenance provider

An experienced Texas truck accident attorney will investigate every angle to hold the right people accountable.

What Can You Recover in a Truck Accident Case?

If you were injured, you may be entitled to compensation for:

  • Medical expenses (now and in the future)

  • Lost wages and loss of earning potential

  • Pain and suffering

  • Emotional distress

  • Property damage

  • Permanent impairment

If a loved one died in a truck accident, you may also pursue a wrongful death claim.

Real Client Story: Injured in West Texas

“David” was driving near Midland when a semi-truck failed to brake in time, causing a pileup. He suffered back injuries and needed months of physical therapy. The trucking company denied fault.

The Lange Firm gathered black box data, driver logs, and maintenance records—and held the company accountable. David received full compensation and closure.

Why Choose The Lange Firm?

  • We only represent injured people—not insurance companies

  • No legal fees unless we win your case

  • Direct access to your attorney

  • We handle truck accident cases across all of Texas

We understand Texas law. We know how to deal with trucking companies. And we care about our clients.

What to Do After a Truck Accident in Texas

  1. Call 911 and seek medical attention immediately

  2. Take photos of the scene and your injuries if possible

  3. Get witness names and contact info

  4. Don’t talk to the trucking company’s insurance

  5. Contact a truck accident lawyer ASAP

Acting quickly can make all the difference.

Call a Texas Truck Accident Lawyer Today

Don’t let the trucking company or their insurer push you around. You have rights—and we’re here to protect them.

Call The Lange Firm today for a no-cost, no-obligation consultation. We’ll review your case, explain your options, and help you move forward.

Let’s fight for the compensation you deserve.
